results.question: What is the summary of the paper 'Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines'?
results.answer: [mock] Top match: 'Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines' (10.1145/3637528.3671812), published 2026-07-22, by Quang Le, Yen Vu. Static benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested.

results.question: Which papers discuss quality gates or data observability for RAG systems?
results.answer: [mock] Top match: 'Data Observability and Quality Gates for Production RAG Systems' (10.1145/3637528.3671802), published 2026-06-12, by Anh Tran, Quoc Pham. Silent data corruption in RAG pipelines degrades LLM answer faithfulness without throwing runtime errors.
